name: Collaborative Project Management Tool
description: Collaborative project management tool for teams to track tasks and projects.

current_prd.elevator_pitch: Our collaborative project management tool empowers teams to streamline task management, enhance communication, and boost productivity. By offering intuitive task tracking, real-time collaboration features, and comprehensive project oversight, we help teams deliver projects on time and within scope, fostering a more organized and efficient work environment.
current_prd.problem_statement: Teams often struggle with disorganized task management, lack of clear communication channels, and inefficient project tracking, leading to missed deadlines, reduced productivity, and project failures.
current_prd.solution: Our solution provides a centralized platform for teams to create, assign, and track tasks, manage projects with clear due dates and priorities, facilitate real-time communication through comments and mentions, and receive timely notifications, ensuring organized workflows and improved project outcomes.

key_features.feature_description: Simple sign-up and login functionality with basic roles: Project Owner and Collaborator.
Ability to create new projects and tasks, assign tasks to collaborators, set due dates, and define task priority (e.g., High, Medium, Low).
Update task status through predefined stages (e.g., To Do, In Progress, Done) and mark tasks as complete.
Centralized view of all tasks within a project, with filters for status and sorting options by due date.
Users can add comments to tasks and use @mentions to notify specific collaborators.
Email or in-app alerts when a user is assigned a task or mentioned in a comment.
Built-in feedback form and analytics integration to collect user input and track usage patterns for continuous improvement.

current_prd.success_metrics: Increase in project completion rates by 20% within six months of launch. Achieve 80% user satisfaction based on feedback surveys. Maintain a 90% task tracking accuracy. Attain 70% active user engagement (daily logins).
current_prd.competitors: Asana, Trello, Jira, Monday.com, ClickUp, Wrike.
current_prd.vision: To become the leading intuitive and collaborative project management platform for small to medium-sized teams, continuously evolving with AI-powered insights and seamless integrations to foster unparalleled productivity and project success.

target_audience.name: Small to Medium-sized Teams
target_audience.pain_points: Dispersed information, communication silos, difficulty tracking progress, missed deadlines.
target_audience.demographics: Teams of 5-50 employees across various industries (e.g., marketing, software development, creative agencies).
target_audience.needs_and_goals: Efficient task organization, improved team communication, centralized project oversight, streamlined workflows.

phasing.rationale: This phase establishes the fundamental capabilities of the project management tool, allowing users to register, create projects and tasks, assign them, track their status, and view them in a centralized dashboard. This is a launch-able version for early adopters or a strong demo for stakeholders, addressing the core problem of disorganized task management and inefficient tracking.

Building upon the MVP, this phase introduces critical features for team collaboration and communication. Users can now interact directly within tasks through comments and mentions, and receive timely alerts. This directly addresses the 'lack of clear communication channels' and significantly enhances team productivity, making it suitable for a beta launch or a more comprehensive demo.

This phase focuses on continuous improvement and understanding user behavior. By integrating feedback mechanisms and usage analytics, the team can gather valuable insights to iterate on the product, ensuring it evolves to meet user needs effectively. This phase is ideal for a post-beta launch or a full public launch where data-driven decisions are crucial for product growth.

current_prd.design_principles:
Clarity & Simplicity: The interface should be intuitive and easy to navigate, minimizing cognitive load for users managing projects and tasks.
Efficiency: Streamline workflows for common actions like task creation, assignment, and status updates to maximize user productivity.
Collaboration-Centric: Design features that foster seamless communication and teamwork, such as comments and notifications.
User Control & Feedback: Provide users with clear control over their projects and tasks, and offer immediate feedback on their actions.
Accessibility: Ensure the design is usable by a diverse range of users, adhering to accessibility best practices.

current_prd.mermaid_erd_diagram:
erDiagram
  USER ||--o{ PROJECT : owns
  USER ||--o{ TASK : assigns
  USER ||--o{ COMMENT : makes
  USER ||--o{ NOTIFICATION : receives
  USER }o--o{ FEEDBACK : provides
  PROJECT ||--o{ TASK : contains
  TASK ||--o{ COMMENT : has

  USER {
    INT id
    VARCHAR email
    VARCHAR password_hash
    VARCHAR name
    VARCHAR role
  }
  PROJECT {
    INT id
    VARCHAR name
    TEXT description
    INT owner_id
  }
  TASK {
    INT id
    INT project_id
    INT assigned_to_user_id
    VARCHAR title
    TEXT description
    TIMESTAMP due_date
    VARCHAR priority
    VARCHAR status
  }
  COMMENT {
    INT id
    INT task_id
    INT user_id
    TEXT content
    TIMESTAMP created_at
  }
  NOTIFICATION {
    INT id
    INT user_id
    VARCHAR type
    TEXT message
    BOOLEAN is_read
    TIMESTAMP created_at
  }
  FEEDBACK {
    INT id
    INT user_id
    TEXT feedback_text
    TIMESTAMP created_at
  }
